hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook singleton implementing a per-pool buyback-and-burn mechanism: a "shield" absorbs sells from a funded donation pot at the pool's own execution price (via beforeSwapReturnsDelta), and a "pump" spends pot secondary tokens to buy back the main token on incoming buys (via a nested self-call swap in afterSwap). Supports optional auto-compounding LP programs with configurable fee splitting.
